'''16AA889 Starfield Road''' was a three story house owned by [[Tanass Brila]] and [[Renia Brila]]. It was located on [[Starfield Road]] on a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] industrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] and used as a safehouse for the local [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel cell]].<ref name="H&S" />

==Layout==
The upper level had a large study and overlooked the courtyard area on the mid-level.<ref name="H&S" />

The mid-level had the living areas, including a master suite, guest bedrooms, and kitchen. There was a secluded courtyard with a pool on this level.<ref name="H&S" />

The lower level contained a garage for parking [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] and a workshop with various tools. There was also a hidden room located in the center of this level accessible via a secret door located in the workshop. A trapdoor in the ceiling of the workshop provided hidden access to the master suite on the floor above.<ref name="H&S" />
